encodingDesc.p: The page image is authoritative. Hathi OCR and the 2014 XML are comparison witnesses only. Printed text is not silently corrected. Verse lines use numbered l elements. Citation hierarchy is author.work.fragment.line.

cRefPattern.p: This pointer pattern extracts lines within fragments.

revisionDesc.change: Split the volume-level OCR draft into canonical TLG author and work files. Running-head continuations were folded into their works; wording was not corrected. The page image remains authoritative and the transcription requires human review.

lg.l: οὐ γὰρ τίθεμεν τὸν ἀγῶνα τόνδε τὸν τρόπον
ὥσπερ τέως ἦν, ἀλλὰ καινῶν πραγμάτων.

div.note: Schol. Platon. 335 Bekk. ἐν δὲ τοῖς Ἀριστοφάνους Τελμησσεῦσι (τὸ τέως) ἀντὶ τοῦ πρότερον κεῖται κτλ.
fortasse ex prologo excerpta. de certamine comico poeta loquitur, καινὰς ἰδέας spectatoribus promittens.
Aristides I 277, 6 Iebb. ἡ κωμωδία γε τὸ λοιπόν ἐστιν, ἔλεγον δὲ ἀναφέρων εἰς τοὺς Τελμισσέας τοῦ Ἀριστοφάνους ὡς ἐκεῖ λόγῳ τις ἠγωνίζετο, ἔργῳ δὲ οὔ.
quae verba prorsus obscura sunt. Bergkius Aristophanem scripsisse existimat λόγῳ γὰρ ἠγωνιζόμεσθ', ἔργοισι δ' οὔ. quae artissime videntur coniungenda esse cum fr. 528.
